title: Gloomwing's Dark Forest
story: Gloomwing the Shadow Bat has swallowed all the light in the Whispering Woods, and a lost puppy is somewhere in the dark! Mr 6 knows that 15 fireflies in his lantern jar will glow bright enough to scare Gloomwing away. He has caught 9 fireflies so far.
question: How many more fireflies does Mr 6 need to catch?
hint: Start at 9 and count up to 15. How many counts did it take?
victory: With 15 fireflies blazing like a tiny sun, Gloomwing squeaks and flaps away! Mr 6 follows a happy bark and carries the puppy home.
